question: How can business owners build advanced AI agent systems without expensive hardware or programming expertise?
transcript_excerpt: Advanced AI practitioners use a virtual private server (VPS) running 24 hours a day, seven days a week, costing only $60 per month. A VPS is simply a computer in the cloud that continues running when you close your laptop, keeping all AI agents and operations executing continuously. This accessible infrastructure allows non-technical business owners to deploy custom agents and automations that would otherwise require expensive on-premise servers.
